credits: (IGCS shared UE5 pool, raptoravis UUU 5.8.11 catalog)
notes: Hellblade II is in raptoravis's 'shared UE5 pool only' bucket (no per-game overrides). Camera intercept AOBs come from UUU 5.8.11 shared pool: AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1 (the field-by-field MOV block that copies POV into the camera manager). Two variants below: SSE (UE5 5.3-5.4 era, has wildcards for the lea displacement) and AVX (UE5 5.5+, all literal). Microsoft first-party, no anti-cheat. depth_curve=log because Iceland-like wide outdoor vistas dominate the game.

intercepts.name: camera_struct_intercept_sse
intercepts.description: AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1 (shared UE5 pool, SSE variant). 11 MOV pairs writing the camera POV fields. Match anchors before the | marker, NOP / patch the 48 bytes after.

intercepts.name: camera_struct_intercept_avx
intercepts.description: AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1 (shared UE5 pool, AVX variant). UE5 5.5+ release builds use VEX-encoded movups/movsd.

capture._capture_note: UE5 reversed-Z. Wide outdoor vistas -> log curve for PNG preview; raw depth.exr unaffected for AI training.

camera_write_profile._comment: UE5 standard FMinimalViewInfo at rdx (source ptr of the AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1 copy). Offsets are LWC layout: Location FVector3d (3x double) at 0x00, Rotation FRotator (3x float) at 0x18, FOV at 0x24. Verify with Test after Capture if values look wrong (some UE5.5+ builds insert padding before FOV).
